scripts.test: pnpm run reference:test && lerna run test
scripts.ci:versionup:patch: lerna version patch --no-push --no-git-tag-version --yes && pnpm run commit-version
scripts.ci:versionup:minor: lerna version minor --no-push --no-git-tag-version --yes && pnpm run commit-version
scripts.ci:versionup:major: lerna version major --no-push --no-git-tag-version --yes && pnpm run commit-version
scripts.commit-version: pnpm install --lockfile-only && git add . && git commit -m "chore(release): v$(node -p 'require("./lerna.json").version')"
scripts.copy-changelog: git tag --points-at HEAD | xargs -I{} monorepo-utils-collect-changelog {} | pbcopy
